principle: Roles are qualitative diagnostic lenses. Presence is not a quota, missing is not automatically a flaw, and coverage is never converted into a score.

roles.label: Core engine
roles.description: Cards that create or repeat the deck's defining loop.

roles.label: Battlefield presence
roles.description: Cards that establish, reinforce, or recover contestable boards.

roles.label: Mobility
roles.description: Cards that reposition units or change where pressure can be applied.

roles.label: Showdown interaction
roles.description: Cards that change the quality or outcome of an intended fight.

roles.label: Resource economy
roles.description: Cards that improve energy, rune, card, or action efficiency.

roles.label: Protection
roles.description: Cards that preserve a key unit, engine, or planned line.

roles.label: Closer
roles.description: Cards or packages that convert an advantage into the deck's endgame.

roles.label: Flex / replacement
roles.description: Contextual slots and substitutes whose job depends on pool, budget, or expected environment.
